mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE level and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 thousand units signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 2000.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong economic growth that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase) fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an active monetary policy supporting economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and INDPRO rise) fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (high GDP growth and low unemployment), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a potential slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods (defined by GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and UNRATE < 5.0%), the HOUST decline signal fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for HOUST decline in these periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (low industrial production growth and high unemployment), a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals improved supply conditions that boost equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply-constrained periods (INDPRO growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%), the INDPRO rise signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO rise in these periods is below 0.03.
